description: Sidewinder edition pack for the medical career field: a team+skill pack bundling clinical craft refinement with care-team coordination. Entries mix austere clinical how-tos (diagnose-first care with limited resources), career-skill entries for refining clinical craft and mentoring, and team-play entries for how care teams coordinate, improvise together under pressure, train each other, and hand off patients safely. The pack builds toward personal refinement tools for medical teams and individual clinicians. Professional help first, always: improvisation is last resort, standard first-aid/wilderness-level only, no DIY surgery ever.
name: Medical
notes_for_main_builder: Draft manifest for the editions framework to validate. Prerequisite graph is internal to this pack (sw-crisis-* ids only). Entry ids follow the repo schema law sw-<domain>-NNN (domain=crisis), which supersedes the 'medical-NNN' format suggested in the build brief. Titles hand-deduped; validation script confirms. Deliberately excludes First Responder topics (scene safety, triage basics, rescue carries/extrication, emergency comms) to avoid overlap with that separate pack. Kind mix tracked per entry in the 'notes' field: 16 field-howto, 14 career-skill, 12 team-play.
safety_posture: Professional help first, always: every crisis entry's first stop condition calls for professional help before any improvisation.
Improvisation is last resort when no help or equipment is coming; standard first-aid and wilderness-level techniques only.
No DIY surgery, ever; entries diagnose up to the licensed-clinician line and stop there.
Every crisis entry carries an explicit 'do not attempt if...' stop condition plus scope-of-license boundaries.
Mentoring, team-play, and career entries develop staff within their existing license; none authorize new scope or unsupervised patient care.
